g.text: 1. Dimensions in mm, elevations in m. Grade = EL 100.000.
2. Thicknesses are FEED minimum nominal (CFU-000-ME-CAL-001); fabricator to verify.
3. Nozzle orientations preliminary - to be confirmed by piping study.
4. Platforms 1200 wide, 60 % wrap; caged ladders not shown in full.
6. Strippers fed by gravity from C-101 draw trays; vapour returns above draw trays.
7. PSV-1009 common to C-102/103/104 (locked-open valves) - HOLD.
8. Skirt heights set by NPSH of P-109/110/111 (CAL-001 S9).
GRAVITY FEED CHECK (C-101 DRAW -> STRIPPER N1)
